settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The main settings panel, opened by the gear icon. Contains game options and the Administrator section.

items.label: How to play
items.description: Opens the How to Play help panel with controls and instructions.

items.label: Music: ON
items.description: Toggles the background music on or off.

items.label: Engine sounds: ON
items.description: Toggles vehicle engine sounds on or off.

items.label: UI sounds: ON
items.description: Toggles the user interface click and notification sounds on or off.

items.label: Record: OFF
items.description: Starts or stops the in-game screen recorder (saves video to the device).

items.label: Gameplay
items.description: Opens the Gameplay submenu (New game, Restart level, Save game, Load game).

items.label: Advanced Properties ▶
items.description: Opens Advanced Properties — zone unlocking by password.

items.label: Move controls ✎
items.description: Opens Move controls: drag the on-screen controls to where you want them on this screen.

items.label: Go to 🧭
items.description: Opens Go To: search a street or place by name and travel straight there.

items.label: Re-download Map
items.description: Re-downloads the latest map data (roads, zones) from GitHub.

items.label: Re-download UI
items.description: Re-downloads the latest user interface files from GitHub.

items.label: Re-download Vehicles
items.description: Re-downloads the latest vehicle models and data from GitHub.

items.label: Re-download Music
items.description: Re-downloads the latest music files from GitHub.

items.label: Live UI updates: ON
items.description: When on, the game checks for UI updates automatically in the background.

items.label: Check for updates now
items.description: Immediately checks GitHub for new UI, map, vehicle, or music updates.

items.label: Stay Awake: OFF
items.description: Keeps the phone screen from sleeping while the game is running.

items.label: Apply UI update — keep my spot
items.description: Applies a downloaded UI update right away and puts you back where you were playing.

items.label: Download newest UI
items.description: Downloads the newest UI files from GitHub (only the changed ones, verified), then reloads the game into them where you left off.

items.label: Road Dispatch Log
items.description: Opens the road dispatch log showing road crew activity and reports.

items.label: Test Connection
items.description: Tests the connection to GitHub to verify downloads will work.

items.label: Send Reports to Joshua Arnold
items.description: Uploads collected bug reports and diagnostics to GitHub for the developer to review.

ungrouped.label: Close
ungrouped.description: Closes the Settings panel and returns to the game.

gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.description: The gameplay submenu: start new games, restart, save, and load.

ungrouped.label: New game
ungrouped.description: Start a new game from the beginning. Applies any staged map or UI updates first.

ungrouped.label: Restart level
ungrouped.description: Restart the current game session from the last checkpoint.

ungrouped.label: Save game
ungrouped.description: Save the current game progress to a slot.

ungrouped.label: Load game
ungrouped.description: Load a previously saved game from a slot.

ungrouped.label: Back
ungrouped.description: Go back to the Settings panel.

ungrouped.label: Exit
ungrouped.description: Exit the game. Asks whether to save first: Save, Continue, or Save and Exit.

pause.title: Paused
pause.description: The pause menu: shown when the game is paused (Escape or the pause button). Resume, or open Move controls to rearrange the on-screen controls.

ungrouped.label: ▶ Resume
ungrouped.description: Closes the pause menu and resumes play.

ungrouped.label: ✎ Move controls
ungrouped.description: Opens Move controls from the pause menu: rearrange the on-screen controls.

advprops.title: Advanced Properties
advprops.description: Advanced Properties: zone unlocking by password. One row per zone (built by the game), Unlock All Zones, and Back to Settings.

ungrouped.label: (Zone list)
ungrouped.description: The zone rows the game builds here: one per zone, showing locked/unlocked; tapping a locked zone asks for its password.

ungrouped.label: 🔓 Unlock All Zones
ungrouped.description: Asks for the Unlock All password and unlocks every zone at once.

ungrouped.label: Back
ungrouped.description: Returns to Settings.

advpass.title: Zone Password
advpass.description: The zone password dialog: type the zone's password to unlock it (or the Unlock All password).

ungrouped.label: Unlock
ungrouped.description: Tries the typed password: unlocks the zone (or all zones) if it matches.

ungrouped.label: Cancel
ungrouped.description: Closes the password dialog without unlocking anything.

zonepick.title: What zone?
zonepick.description: Zone picker shown on New Game (after the first game): pick which zone to start in.

ungrouped.label: (Zone list)
ungrouped.description: Scrollable list of available zones. Generated from the game's zone data.

ungrouped.label: Cancel
ungrouped.description: Cancel zone selection and go back.

saveexit.title: Save game?
saveexit.description: Save prompt when exiting: Save, Continue, or Save and Exit.

ungrouped.label: Save
ungrouped.description: Save the game to a slot and keep playing.

ungrouped.label: Continue
ungrouped.description: Return to the game without saving.

ungrouped.label: Save and Exit
ungrouped.description: Save the game to a slot, then exit the game entirely.

slotpick.title: Choose a save slot
slotpick.description: Save-slot picker: shown after Save / Save and Exit — pick one of the save slots.

ungrouped.label: (Save slot list)
ungrouped.description: The save slots the game lists here: pick one to save into (an occupied slot asks before overwriting).

ungrouped.label: Cancel
ungrouped.description: Closes the slot picker without saving.

admconfirm.title: Confirm Re-download
admconfirm.description: Confirmation asked before a manual re-download: names the asset and its current version; Yes wipes the old files and downloads fresh, No cancels.

ungrouped.label: Yes
ungrouped.description: Confirms the re-download: old files of that type are wiped and downloaded fresh.

ungrouped.label: No
ungrouped.description: Cancels the re-download — nothing is changed.

zoneload.title: Unlocking Zone
zoneload.description: The zone-unlock download screen: progress bar while the unlocked zone's data downloads; Retry, Cancel, or Continue when it lands.

ungrouped.label: ↻ Retry download
ungrouped.description: Retries the zone download after a failure.

ungrouped.label: Cancel
ungrouped.description: Cancels the unlock — the zone stays locked.

ungrouped.label: ▶ Continue
ungrouped.description: Continues into the unlocked zone once its data has downloaded.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: The backpack inventory panel: what the player is carrying, with a Close button. Items are listed by the game.

ungrouped.label: (Item list)
ungrouped.description: The items the player is carrying, listed by the game; tapping an item can drop it.

ungrouped.label: Close
ungrouped.description: Closes the inventory panel.

npcdialog.title: Conversation
npcdialog.description: The conversation box shown when talking to a person in the game: their name, what they say, and the Bye button.

ungrouped.label: BYE
ungrouped.description: Ends the conversation.

fullmap.title: Full Map
fullmap.description: The full map overlay: the whole map, a legend, and buttons for Satellite View, GPS Navigate, and clearing the GPS route.

ungrouped.description: Closes the full map and returns to the game.

ungrouped.label: 🛰️ Satellite View
ungrouped.description: Opens Satellite View from the full map.

ungrouped.label: 📍 Navigate
ungrouped.description: Starts GPS navigation to the tapped point on the map.

ungrouped.label: ✖ Clear GPS
ungrouped.description: Clears the current GPS route.

satview.title: Satellite View
satview.description: Satellite view controls: switch 2D/3D, zoom in and out, re-center on the player, and close.

ungrouped.label: 3D
ungrouped.description: Switches Satellite View between 2D and 3D.

ungrouped.label: Zoom in
ungrouped.description: Zooms Satellite View in.

ungrouped.label: Zoom out
ungrouped.description: Zooms Satellite View out.

ungrouped.label: Center on player
ungrouped.description: Centers Satellite View back on the player.

ungrouped.label: Close Satellite View
ungrouped.description: Closes Satellite View.

hudmove.title: Move Controls
hudmove.description: The Move controls bar: shown while arranging the on-screen controls — drag controls to their spots; Select control lists them, Reset restores the screen's designed layout, Done finishes.

ungrouped.label: Reset this screen
ungrouped.description: Restores this screen's designed control layout (undoes your dragging).

ungrouped.label: ✓ Done
ungrouped.description: Finishes arranging and returns to the game.

ungrouped.label: Select control ▾
ungrouped.description: Lists every movable control by name — pick one to select it (off-screen controls can be brought back to the center).

ungrouped.label: Hide ▾
ungrouped.description: Collapses the Move controls bar to its slim tab so the screen is clear for dragging.

ungrouped.label: ✎ Move controls ▴
ungrouped.description: The collapsed Move controls tab: tap to bring the bar back.

goto.title: Go To
goto.description: The Go To panel: search the game's streets and places by name and travel straight there. Opened by the compass button or from Settings.

ungrouped.label: Close Go to
ungrouped.description: Closes the Go To panel.

launcher.title: Launch Options
launcher.description: Pre-game options screen: pick which systems run and graphics quality before starting.

items.label: NPCs (1,000 citizens)
items.description: Enable the 1,000 NPC citizens walking around the city. Heavy on performance.

items.label: Work crews (all)
items.description: Enable all work crews (road, survey, infrastructure, HQ staff).

items.label: Road crew
items.description: Enable the road maintenance crew.

items.label: Survey fleet
items.description: Enable the survey vehicles driving around.

items.label: Infra crew
items.description: Enable the infrastructure crew.

items.label: HQ staff
items.description: Enable the headquarters staff NPCs.

items.label: MARTA buses
items.description: Enable MARTA buses driving their routes.

items.label: MARTA trains
items.description: Enable MARTA trains on the rail lines.

items.label: Airplane drones (50)
items.description: Enable 50 airplane drones flying overhead.

items.label: Ambient traffic
items.description: Enable background traffic vehicles on the roads.

items.label: Shadows
items.description: Enable real-time shadows. Light on performance.

items.label: Antialiasing
items.description: Smooth jagged edges. Heavy on performance.

items.label: High-detail buildings
items.description: Use high-detail building models. Medium performance impact.

items.label: Draw distance
items.description: How far the game draws the world: Short (fastest), Medium, or Long.

items.label: Quality
items.description: Graphics quality: Auto lets the game step quality up and down to hold its frame rate; or lock Full / High / Medium / Low.

ungrouped.label: SELECT ALL
ungrouped.description: Turn on all launch options.

ungrouped.label: SELECT NONE
ungrouped.description: Turn off all launch options.

ungrouped.label: WEAK HARDWARE
ungrouped.description: Preset for weak devices: turns off heavy options.

ungrouped.label: START GAME
ungrouped.description: Start the game with the selected options.

ungrouped.label: Start Anyway
ungrouped.description: Start the game anyway, ignoring performance warnings.

help.title: How to play
help.description: The help panel with game instructions. Informational — not interactive items.

ungrouped.label: Got it
ungrouped.description: Close the help panel and return to the game.
